description: Suijin OS v7.0.0 — The Command Center Release. `suijn operator`: one screen commanding every agent — live cards, per-agent iteration history, confirmed-exploits-only counts, System One status, and a command line that broadcasts (/say), holds the whole team between turns (/pause), or su's into a single engagement to steer it. The knowledge graph grows teeth: Neo4j backend (persistent, one switch, loud JSON fallback), enforced per-turn reads the agent cannot skip, and terminal-confirmed exploits that fan out to the graph, the mesh and the notes without model choice. Live-engagement fixes: same-second parallel engagements no longer share one audit trail, closed windows fully quit and vanish from the roster, and only POC-verifier-CONFIRMED exploits count as findings. Lab/real isolation: class-transfer ignores lab catalogs, FLAG{} markers are rejected on real targets. README rewritten product-first. 2,798+ tests green.
